artists.name: Action Bronson
artists.bio: Action Bronson is an American rapper, former chef and television personality from Queens, New York. Known for his colourful storytelling, witty lyricism and distinctive voice, he has built a career that extends beyond music. Albums such as Mr. Wonderful, Blue Chips 7000 and Only for Dolphins showcase his unconventional creative style. He has collaborated with prominent producers including The Alchemist and Harry Fraud. Through television projects such as F*ck, That's Delicious, he has also become a recognisable figure in food, travel and popular culture.

artists.name: Adrian Younge
artists.bio: Adrian Younge is an American composer, producer and multi-instrumentalist recognised for his cinematic analogue production and ambitious musical projects. His work blends soul, jazz, hip-hop and film-score influences, often drawing inspiration from vintage recording techniques. He has collaborated with artists including Ghostface Killah and Ali Shaheed Muhammad, with whom he created The Midnight Hour. He is also a co-founder of the Jazz Is Dead project, which brings together influential musicians and contemporary audiences. His work bridges musical history with new creative approaches to recording and composition.

artists.name: The Alchemist
artists.bio: The Alchemist is one of the most influential hip-hop producers of his generation, known for his unmistakable sample-based production and cinematic sound. Over a career spanning three decades, he has worked with artists including Nas, Mobb Deep, Eminem, Kendrick Lamar and Earl Sweatshirt. His collaborative album Alfredo with Freddie Gibbs received a Grammy nomination for Best Rap Album, and the pair reunited for Alfredo 2 in 2025. Projects with artists such as Action Bronson, Boldy James, Roc Marciano and Larry June have further cemented his reputation as a defining figure in contemporary hip-hop. His ability to bridge classic underground production with modern rap has made him one of the genre's most respected creative forces.

artists.name: Âo
artists.bio: Âo is a Belgian band whose music brings together electronic production, alternative pop and Portuguese-language influences. Their sound combines expressive vocals, organic instrumentation and atmospheric arrangements. Moving between intimate melodies and rhythmic electronic textures, the group creates music that feels both contemporary and emotionally rich. Their distinctive approach reflects a mix of cultural influences and an interest in exploring sounds beyond conventional genre boundaries.

artists.name: Apollo Brown
artists.bio: Apollo Brown is an American hip-hop producer recognised for his soulful sampling and classic boom-bap sound. His production is characterised by warm textures, atmospheric melodies and hard-hitting drums. He has collaborated with respected artists including O.C., Skyzoo and Guilty Simpson. Albums such as Trophies and The Easy Truth have helped establish his reputation within independent hip-hop. His work reflects a deep connection to traditional sampling techniques and timeless rap production.

artists.name: Arthur Verocai
artists.bio: Arthur Verocai is a Brazilian composer, arranger and musician whose work has become highly influential across jazz, soul, hip-hop and Brazilian music. His self-titled 1972 album, initially overlooked, later gained cult status for its sophisticated orchestral arrangements and innovative production. The record became especially influential among hip-hop producers and music collectors, with its compositions sampled by prominent artists. Verocai's music combines Brazilian rhythms, psychedelic influences and cinematic orchestration. His rediscovery and continued performances have introduced his work to new generations of listeners around the world.

artists.name: Asher Roth
artists.bio: Asher Roth is an American rapper who gained international recognition with his breakout single I Love College and debut album Asleep in the Bread Aisle. His early success introduced his playful lyricism and relaxed delivery to mainstream audiences. Over time, he developed a more independent musical direction, experimenting with jazz, soul and alternative hip-hop influences. His work reflects a career shaped by artistic growth, individuality and a willingness to move beyond commercial expectations.

artists.name: B-Real
artists.bio: B-Real is an American rapper best known as the lead vocalist of Cypress Hill. His unmistakable high-pitched voice and distinctive delivery became central to the group's international success. Through recordings such as Insane in the Brain and Hits from the Bong, he helped establish one of hip-hop's most recognisable sounds. Beyond Cypress Hill, he has developed solo projects and collaborations across rap and rock. His influence extends into music, media and contemporary popular culture.

artists.name: Benny Sings
artists.bio: Benny Sings is a Dutch singer, songwriter and producer celebrated for his distinctive blend of pop, soul, jazz and soft rock. His music is characterised by warm melodies, understated grooves and sophisticated songwriting. He has collaborated with artists including Mac DeMarco, Tom Misch and Rex Orange County, reaching an international audience. Albums such as Music and Young Hearts showcase his ability to combine timeless influences with contemporary production. His unmistakable sound has made him a respected figure in modern independent pop.

artists.name: Black Milk
artists.bio: Black Milk is an American rapper, producer and musician from Detroit known for his innovative production and rhythmic experimentation. His work blends hip-hop with soul, jazz, funk and electronic influences. Albums such as Tronic and Album of the Year showcase his evolving approach to sound and composition. He has collaborated with respected artists and musicians across the hip-hop community. His work reflects Detroit's rich musical heritage while pushing the boundaries of contemporary rap production.

artists.name: Blu & Exile
artists.bio: Blu & Exile are an influential American hip-hop duo consisting of rapper Blu and producer Exile. Their 2007 album Below the Heavens is widely regarded as a modern underground hip-hop classic. The project introduced their signature combination of introspective storytelling, soulful samples and carefully crafted production. Their subsequent releases have continued to explore personal themes while maintaining a strong connection to traditional hip-hop. Together, they have built a lasting reputation for authenticity and musical chemistry.

artists.name: Boot Camp Clik
artists.bio: Boot Camp Clik are an influential Brooklyn hip-hop collective bringing together members of Black Moon, Smif-N-Wessun, Heltah Skeltah and O.G.C. Emerging during the 1990s, they became known for their raw production and distinctive East Coast sound. Their collaborative approach helped establish the wider Duck Down Records community. Albums such as For the People showcase their collective identity and lyrical strength. Their influence remains important within underground hip-hop culture.

artists.name: Chali 2na
artists.bio: Chali 2na is an American rapper and vocalist best known as a member of Jurassic 5 and Ozomatli. His exceptionally deep voice and distinctive delivery have made him one of hip-hop's most recognisable performers. With Jurassic 5, he helped bring a classic, collaborative approach to rap to international audiences. His solo career combines hip-hop, funk and live instrumentation, often incorporating his interests in visual art. His work has made him a respected figure in alternative hip-hop and live music culture.

artists.name: Clinton Fearon
artists.bio: Clinton Fearon is a Jamaican singer, songwriter and bassist whose career spans more than five decades. Best known for his 18 years with the legendary roots reggae band The Gladiators, he helped shape classics such as “Chatty Chatty Mouth” and “Richman Poorman.” He also worked with influential producers including Coxsone Dodd and Lee “Scratch” Perry. Since launching his solo career, Fearon has continued to bring his distinctive voice, soulful melodies and socially conscious songwriting to audiences worldwide, remaining an influential figure in roots reggae.

artists.name: The Cool Kids
artists.bio: The Cool Kids are an American hip-hop duo consisting of Chuck Inglish and Sir Michael Rocks. Emerging in the late 2000s, they became influential for their minimalist production, playful lyricism and distinctive fashion sense. Their early releases, including The Bake Sale, helped define a new generation of alternative hip-hop. Their music draws inspiration from classic rap while maintaining a modern and independent creative identity. Beyond their recordings, the duo have influenced the intersection of hip-hop, streetwear and youth culture.

artists.name: Cypress Hill
artists.bio: Cypress Hill are one of the most influential hip-hop groups to emerge from Los Angeles. Their distinctive sound combines heavy bass, psychedelic production and the unmistakable vocals of B-Real. Albums such as Cypress Hill and Black Sunday helped establish their international success, with Insane in the Brain becoming a defining hip-hop anthem. The group played an important role in bringing Latin American representation into mainstream hip-hop. Their music has also crossed into rock and alternative culture, creating a lasting influence beyond rap.

artists.name: De La Soul
artists.bio: De La Soul are one of the most influential groups in hip-hop history, recognised for their originality, humour and groundbreaking use of sampling. Their 1989 debut album 3 Feet High and Rising, produced by Prince Paul, transformed the possibilities of alternative hip-hop and was inducted into the Grammy Hall of Fame. As members of the Native Tongues movement, they helped introduce a more imaginative and eclectic approach to rap alongside artists such as A Tribe Called Quest. Albums including De La Soul Is Dead and Stakes Is High further established their artistic legacy. Their influence continues to be felt across generations of hip-hop and alternative music.

artists.name: Dilated Peoples
artists.bio: Dilated Peoples are an influential Los Angeles hip-hop group consisting of Evidence, Rakaa and DJ Babu. Known for their lyrical precision, turntablism and classic underground production, they became important figures in West Coast independent rap. Their breakthrough single Worst Comes to Worst remains one of their most recognisable recordings. Albums such as The Platform and Expansion Team helped establish their international following. Their sound has played an important role in preserving the traditions of lyric-focused, DJ-driven hip-hop.

artists.name: DJ Premier
artists.bio: DJ Premier is widely regarded as one of the greatest producers in hip-hop history. As one half of Gang Starr alongside Guru, he helped define the sound of East Coast rap through classic albums including Step in the Arena, Daily Operation and Moment of Truth. His signature production style combines hard-hitting drums, jazz-influenced samples and intricate turntable scratching. He has produced for legendary artists including Nas, Jay-Z, The Notorious B.I.G. and Christina Aguilera. His influence on hip-hop production extends across generations and continues to shape the genre today.

artists.name: Dom Kennedy
artists.bio: Dom Kennedy is an American rapper from Los Angeles known for his relaxed delivery and distinctive West Coast sound. His music captures Southern California culture through laid-back production and conversational storytelling. Releases such as From the Westside with Love and The Yellow Album helped establish his independent career. He has maintained a strong connection to his audience through consistent releases and an independent approach to the music industry. His work represents a modern continuation of West Coast hip-hop traditions.

artists.name: Elephant Gym
artists.bio: Elephant Gym is a Taiwanese instrumental band celebrated for its intricate rhythms, melodic bass lines and genre-crossing compositions. Their music combines math rock, jazz, funk and progressive influences. Known for technically impressive performances, the group creates complex arrangements that remain expressive and accessible. Their albums and international touring have helped introduce Taiwanese instrumental music to audiences worldwide. Their distinctive sound has made them one of the recognised names in contemporary Asian math rock.

artists.name: Elephant Kind
artists.bio: Elephant Kind is an Indonesian alternative band known for combining indie rock, pop and electronic influences. Their music is characterised by energetic production, melodic songwriting and an adventurous creative identity. Through releases and live performances, they have developed an audience in Indonesia and internationally. Their approach reflects the growing influence of Southeast Asian alternative music on the global independent scene.

artists.name: Elmiene
artists.bio: Elmiene is a British-Sudanese singer-songwriter known for his soulful vocals and distinctive blend of R&B, soul and contemporary influences. Since his debut in 2022, he has quickly gained international recognition, earning nominations at the BRIT Awards and The Ivors, performing alongside Stevie Wonder and SZA, and appearing on NPR's Tiny Desk. With influences ranging from Stevie Wonder to Prince, Elmiene continues to push the boundaries of modern soul music. His debut album, sounds for someone, explores love, loss and personal connection, marking an exciting new chapter in his career.

artists.name: Fashawn
artists.bio: Fashawn is an American rapper from Fresno, California, recognised for his storytelling and introspective lyricism. His debut album Boy Meets World, produced by Exile, received widespread critical praise within independent hip-hop. The project introduced his ability to combine personal narratives with soulful production. He later continued developing his career through releases and collaborations with prominent hip-hop artists. His music reflects themes of ambition, personal growth and everyday life.

artists.name: Freddie Gibbs
artists.bio: Freddie Gibbs is an American rapper celebrated for his technical precision, powerful delivery and vivid storytelling. His collaborations with producer Madlib, particularly Piñata and Bandana, are widely regarded as standout modern hip-hop releases. His album Alfredo, produced by The Alchemist, earned a Grammy nomination for Best Rap Album. In 2025, Gibbs and The Alchemist reunited for Alfredo 2. His ability to combine street narratives with sophisticated production has made him one of the most acclaimed rappers of his generation.

artists.name: Gabriele Poso
artists.bio:
Gabriele Poso is an Italian percussionist, multi-instrumentalist, composer and producer whose music brings together Afro-Latin rhythms, jazz, soul and Mediterranean influences. Born in Sardinia and raised in Lecce, he developed his musical approach through studies in Italy, Puerto Rico and Cuba, building a distinctive sound rooted in rhythm and experimentation.

Over the years, he has collaborated with artists including Osunlade and Louie Vega and released music through labels such as Yoruba Records, BBE and Wonderwheel Recordings. His projects include Tamburo Infinito, Ritmo Italiano and his 2026 album Maraviglia, which combines Afro-Caribbean percussion, jazz and Mediterranean grooves. Known for his energetic live performances, Poso continues to connect musical traditions with contemporary sounds.

artists.name: Gaidaa
artists.bio: Gaidaa is a Sudanese-Dutch singer-songwriter whose music blends contemporary R&B, soul and jazz influences. Her expressive vocals and deeply personal songwriting explore identity, relationships and emotional growth. Drawing inspiration from her multicultural background, she creates music that feels intimate while connecting with a broad international audience. Her work combines soulful arrangements with a modern, independent artistic identity.

artists.name: GoldLink
artists.bio: GoldLink is an American rapper known for blending hip-hop with house, R&B and electronic dance music. His early work helped introduce the concept of future bounce, a sound combining rhythmic club production with rap. His breakthrough single Crew, featuring Brent Faiyaz and Shy Glizzy, received a Grammy nomination and achieved major commercial success. Albums such as At What Cost showcase his ability to connect different musical scenes and influences. His genre-crossing approach has made him a distinctive figure in contemporary hip-hop.

artists.name: Guilty Simpson
artists.bio: Guilty Simpson is an American rapper from Detroit recognised for his commanding delivery and direct lyrical style. His career is closely associated with the city's influential underground hip-hop scene. His debut album Ode to the Ghetto, released through Stones Throw Records, featured production from artists including J Dilla and Madlib. His collaborations with respected producers have established him as a distinctive voice in independent rap. His music reflects Detroit's musical heritage and uncompromising creative identity.

artists.name: Hyphen Dash
artists.bio: Hyphen Dash is a contemporary instrumental group exploring the space between jazz, hip-hop, funk and electronic music. Their sound is driven by rhythmic experimentation, improvisation and groove-oriented arrangements. By combining live musicianship with modern production influences, the group creates an energetic and distinctive musical experience. Their approach reflects a new generation of artists bringing instrumental music into contemporary music culture.

artists.name: Inspectah Deck
artists.bio: Inspectah Deck is an American rapper and founding member of the legendary Wu-Tang Clan, one of the most influential groups in hip-hop history. Known for his intricate lyricism and sharp delivery, he contributed memorable verses to the group's groundbreaking debut Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers) and subsequent recordings. His verse on Triumph remains one of the most celebrated performances in the Wu-Tang catalogue. Beyond his work with the group, he has released solo projects and performed with the hip-hop collective Czarface. His contributions have helped shape the sound and legacy of East Coast hip-hop.

artists.name: izabalien
artists.bio: izabalien is a Bulgarian-born, London-based singer-songwriter blending alternative R&B, pop and contemporary urban influences. A graduate of BIMM, she has developed a sound shaped by expressive vocals, personal storytelling and a confident artistic identity. Her 2024 EP SCENARIOS introduced her musical world through emotionally driven songs and modern production. She has also participated in creative music initiatives including an SBTV songwriting camp and the She Runs The Board compilation. Her evolving sound brings together R&B influences, bold visual storytelling and a strong connection to fashion and digital culture.

artists.name: Kassa Overall
artists.bio:
A Seattle native, Kassa Overall is a Grammy-nominated jazz artist, drummer, emcee, singer and producer. He seamlessly blends jazz, hip-hop and avant-garde experimentation into a sound uniquely his own. His music is both innovative and accessible, pushing the boundaries of genre while remaining deeply engaging.

Kassa Overall has released six critically acclaimed mixtapes and albums, including I Think I’m Good and Go Get Ice Cream and Listen to Jazz. His project ANIMALS explores the complexities of his identity as an artist and a Black man in America, featuring collaborations with an eclectic mix of musicians, from Danny Brown and Lil B to Nick Hakim and Vijay Iyer.

artists.name: Lute
artists.bio: Lute is an American rapper from Charlotte, North Carolina, known for his thoughtful lyricism and soulful production. As an artist associated with Dreamville Records, he has reached audiences through solo projects and collaborations within the label's creative community. His album Gold Mouf explores personal growth, family and the realities of everyday life. His music combines traditional hip-hop influences with a modern, emotionally honest approach. Through reflective storytelling, he has developed a distinctive voice in contemporary rap.

artists.name: Mad Keys
artists.bio: Mad Keys is a musician, keyboardist and producer whose work moves between jazz, soul, hip-hop and contemporary instrumental music. His sound is built around expressive keyboard performances, improvisation and groove-driven arrangements. By combining live musicality with modern production, he creates a distinctive atmosphere that connects traditional influences with contemporary sounds. His work reflects a strong focus on musicianship and creative experimentation.

artists.name: Marco Polo
artists.bio: Marco Polo is a Canadian hip-hop producer recognised for his classic boom-bap production and dedication to sample-based music. He has worked with respected artists including Masta Ace, Pharoahe Monch and members of the wider underground hip-hop community. His production is characterised by hard-hitting drums, carefully selected samples and a strong connection to New York hip-hop traditions. Through projects such as Port Authority, he has established himself as a respected producer in independent rap. His work continues to connect different generations of hip-hop artists.

artists.name: Marisa Monte
artists.bio: Marisa Monte is one of Brazil's most celebrated singers and songwriters, known for her distinctive voice and contributions to Brazilian popular music. Her career blends samba, MPB, pop and contemporary influences, creating a sound recognised internationally. She is also a member of the acclaimed musical project Tribalistas alongside Arnaldo Antunes and Carlinhos Brown. Her catalogue includes influential recordings such as Verde, Anil, Amarelo, Cor-de-Rosa e Carvão and Memórias, Crônicas e Declarações de Amor. A multiple Latin Grammy Award winner, she remains one of the defining voices of modern Brazilian music.

artists.name: Mila Robert
artists.bio: Mila Robert is a Bulgarian singer-songwriter and performer known for her bold artistic identity and unconventional approach to pop music. Her work combines contemporary pop with theatrical performance, humour and expressive storytelling. Recognised for her distinctive visual style and energetic stage presence, she has established herself as one of the more individual voices in Bulgaria's contemporary pop scene. Her music often experiments with genre, character and performance, creating a world that extends beyond traditional pop songwriting.

artists.name: Mobb Deep
artists.bio: Mobb Deep were one of the most influential hip-hop duos of the 1990s, consisting of Havoc and Prodigy from Queensbridge, New York. Their landmark album The Infamous helped define the gritty sound of East Coast rap. Songs such as Shook Ones, Pt. II and Survival of the Fittest became enduring hip-hop classics. Their dark production, vivid storytelling and uncompromising lyrics influenced generations of rappers and producers. Their legacy remains central to the history of New York hip-hop.

artists.name: Moonchild
artists.bio: Moonchild are an American neo-soul trio consisting of Amber Navran, Andris Mattson and Max Bryk. Their music combines jazz harmony, contemporary R&B and electronic production with warm, expressive vocals. Albums such as Voyager and Little Ghost have helped establish their international following. The group are known for their intricate arrangements, understated grooves and emotionally rich songwriting. Their work has made them a recognised name in contemporary soul and jazz-influenced R&B.

artists.name: Murs
artists.bio: Murs is an American rapper known for his independent career, thoughtful lyricism and commitment to underground hip-hop. He gained recognition through his work with the Living Legends collective and later through solo releases. His collaborations with producer 9th Wonder, including Murs 3:16: The 9th Edition, became particularly influential within independent rap. His music combines personal storytelling, social commentary and humour. Throughout his career, he has remained closely connected to independent hip-hop culture.

artists.name: Naughty by Nature
artists.bio: Naughty by Nature are a Grammy-winning American hip-hop group known for their energetic sound and crossover success. Their breakthrough hit O.P.P. became one of the defining hip-hop songs of the early 1990s. They followed it with further classics including Hip Hop Hooray, establishing a lasting presence in popular music. Their combination of catchy hooks, powerful delivery and street-oriented lyricism helped bring East Coast rap to mainstream audiences. Their influence remains visible across generations of hip-hop performers.

artists.name: Oddisee
artists.bio: Oddisee is an American rapper, producer and composer known for blending hip-hop with jazz, soul and funk. His music combines thoughtful social commentary, personal storytelling and sophisticated arrangements. Albums such as The Good Fight and The Iceberg showcase his ability to balance lyrical depth with accessible, groove-driven production. He is also recognised for his dynamic live performances with a full band. His independent approach has earned him a dedicated international following.

artists.name: Olivier St. Louis
artists.bio: Olivier St. Louis is a singer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist whose music blends soul, funk, rock and alternative R&B. His distinctive vocal style and adventurous arrangements reflect a wide range of musical influences. He has collaborated with artists and producers across contemporary soul and electronic music, including Oddisee and Hudson Mohawke. His solo work explores the meeting point between expressive songwriting and experimental production. His musical versatility has made him a distinctive voice in modern alternative soul.

artists.name: Protoje
artists.bio: Protoje is a Jamaican reggae artist and one of the leading figures of the modern reggae revival movement. His music blends roots reggae with hip-hop, soul and contemporary production while addressing social and cultural themes. Albums such as Ancient Future and A Matter of Time have helped introduce his sound to international audiences. His collaboration with Chronixx on Who Knows became one of the defining songs of the contemporary reggae movement. Through his recordings and live performances, Protoje continues to connect Jamaican musical traditions with a global audience.

artists.name: Psycho Realm
artists.bio: Psycho Realm are a Los Angeles hip-hop group known for their dark production, intense lyricism and socially conscious themes. Founded by brothers Sick Jacken and Big Duke, the group developed a distinctive sound rooted in underground West Coast rap. Their music explores social conflict, identity and life in urban communities. Their recordings gained a dedicated following through an uncompromising creative approach. Psycho Realm remain an influential name within independent Latino hip-hop culture.

artists.name: Redman
artists.bio: Redman is an influential American rapper known for his energetic delivery, humour and distinctive lyrical style. He rose to prominence in the early 1990s with albums such as Whut? Thee Album and Muddy Waters. His long-running creative partnership with Method Man produced successful recordings and the cult film How High. His ability to combine technical lyricism with personality and entertainment has made him one of East Coast hip-hop's most recognisable figures. His influence continues to be felt across rap and popular culture.

artists.name: Rogê
artists.bio: Rogê is a Brazilian singer-songwriter and guitarist whose music combines samba, MPB, funk and Brazilian soul. Known for his rhythmic guitar playing and warm vocal style, he draws inspiration from the rich traditions of Brazilian popular music. His work connects classic influences with contemporary songwriting and production. Through recordings and international performances, he has introduced his distinctive sound to audiences beyond Brazil. His music reflects a strong connection to Brazilian culture while remaining open to new musical directions.

artists.name: The Roots
artists.bio: The Roots are one of the most influential live hip-hop groups in music history, celebrated for combining rap with jazz, soul, funk and exceptional musicianship. Formed in Philadelphia by Black Thought and Questlove, the band helped redefine hip-hop through its use of live instrumentation. Their landmark album Things Fall Apart and Grammy-winning song You Got Me remain essential recordings in the genre. The group has received multiple Grammy Awards and has served as the house band for The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Their legacy extends beyond recording into live performance, television and contemporary music culture.

artists.name: SadSvit
artists.bio: SadSvit is a Ukrainian musician whose music combines post-punk, indie rock and electronic influences. His atmospheric production and emotionally driven lyrics have resonated with a generation of listeners. His songs often explore nostalgia, personal experiences and the emotional landscape of contemporary life. His work has gained recognition both within Ukraine and internationally, contributing to the visibility of modern Ukrainian alternative music.

artists.name: Sammany
artists.bio: Sammany is a Sudanese musician and beatmaker based in Qatar whose work explores Sudanese musical heritage through contemporary production. His sound brings together archival recordings, traditional musical influences and modern beats. By reinterpreting older Sudanese sounds, he creates music that connects cultural memory with contemporary listening experiences. His work has also reached international audiences through music platforms and projects including COLORS. His approach reflects a strong interest in preserving musical identity while developing new creative possibilities.

artists.name: Sara Chakarova
artists.bio: Sara Chakarova is a Bulgarian percussionist whose artistic background combines classical training with contemporary performance and creative experimentation. She has performed internationally and developed a career shaped by technical musicianship and a strong stage presence. Her work explores the expressive possibilities of percussion through solo performances, collaborations and new musical projects. Alongside her performance career, she is developing her identity as a recording artist and composer. Her approach brings together instrumental virtuosity, creativity and a desire to reach audiences beyond traditional classical music.

artists.name: Sean Price
artists.bio: Sean Price was an influential Brooklyn rapper celebrated for his powerful delivery, sharp lyricism and uncompromising underground style. He first gained recognition as a member of Heltah Skeltah and the Boot Camp Clik collective. His solo albums, including Monkey Barz and Jesus Price Supastar, became highly respected within independent hip-hop. Known for his humour, technical ability and commanding presence, he built a dedicated following. His legacy remains important within East Coast rap following his death in 2015.

artists.name: Skyzoo
artists.bio: Skyzoo is an American rapper from Brooklyn recognised for his intricate lyricism, storytelling and deep connection to East Coast hip-hop. His music combines classic boom-bap production with contemporary themes and detailed personal narratives. Albums such as Music for My Friends and In Celebration of Us demonstrate his approach to conceptual songwriting. He has collaborated with respected producers and artists across the independent hip-hop scene. His work has earned him a reputation as one of the genre's most consistent lyricists.

artists.name: Sunset Rollercoaster
artists.bio: Sunset Rollercoaster is a Taiwanese band known for its dreamy blend of psychedelic pop, soft rock, funk and soul. Their music is characterised by smooth vocals, nostalgic synthesizers and atmospheric arrangements. Albums such as Cassa Nova and Soft Storm helped establish their international following. Their sound draws inspiration from vintage pop and R&B while maintaining a distinctive contemporary identity. Through extensive touring, they have become one of Taiwan's most internationally recognised independent bands.

artists.name: Toshiki Soejima
artists.bio: Toshiki Soejima is a Japanese guitarist and composer recognised for his expressive playing and distinctive neo-soul guitar sound. His music blends jazz harmony, R&B influences and smooth melodic arrangements. Through recordings, performances and online music content, he has developed an international audience of listeners and musicians. His playing style is characterised by warm guitar tones, subtle rhythmic phrasing and an intimate musical atmosphere. He continues to bring contemporary Japanese instrumental music to audiences around the world.

artists.name: Xavier Omär
artists.bio: Xavier Omär is an American singer-songwriter known for his soulful vocals and emotionally direct approach to contemporary R&B. His music combines elements of R&B, gospel and modern electronic production. Through projects such as The Everlasting Wave and Moments Spent Loving You, he has developed a distinctive sound centred on relationships, vulnerability and personal growth. His collaborations with producer Sango have been particularly important in shaping his musical identity. His work has earned him a dedicated audience within alternative R&B.
